title: Dual-Stream LLM-Guided Reward Design for Reject-Inference-Aware Reinforcement Learning in E-Commerce Payment Fraud Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.08706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Production fraud-detection models learn from a censored slice of their own traffic: transactions a legacy system blocked never receive fraud labels, so models train on a biased, approved-only distribution. We extend LLM-guided reward design, the framework of Qu et al. (2025) in which an LLM evolves the reward of a two-step REINFORCE fraud-blocking policy, to attack this reject-inference problem inside the reward. A single LLM designs a dual-stream reward: stream 1 applies the standard dollar-weighted precision objective to labeled transactions; stream 2 scores legacy-blocked, unlabeled transactions by contrasting the newest gradient-boosted risk signal against the legacy scores that drove the original block. Rather than prescribe which signals matter, we expose a superset of evidence and let the LLM decide for itself which to use, guided by evaluation feedback alone; because it writes the reward as code, that choice is directly auditab

translated_title: 电子商务支付欺诈检测中面向拒绝推断感知强化学习的双流LLM引导奖励设计
translated_abstract: 生产级欺诈检测模型只能从其自身流量的被截断部分中学习：被旧系统拦截的交易永远不会获得欺诈标签，因此模型只能在有偏的、仅包含已通过交易的分布上进行训练。我们扩展了LLM引导的奖励设计——即Qu等人（2025）提出的框架，其中LLM演化两步REINFORCE欺诈拦截策略的奖励——以在奖励函数内部解决这一拒绝推断问题。单个LLM设计出双流奖励：流1对有标签交易应用标准的美元加权精确率目标；流2通过将最新的梯度提升风险信号与驱动原始拦截决策的旧系统评分进行对比，为被旧系统拦截的无标签交易打分。我们并不预先规定哪些信号重要，而是提供证据的超集，让LLM仅凭评估反馈自行决定使用哪些信号；由于它将奖励编写为代码，这一选择是直接可审计的。
tldr: 该论文提出由单个LLM设计的双流奖励机制，通过让LLM自行决策如何利用风险信号对比新旧评分，为被旧系统拦截的无标签交易打分，从而在强化学习欺诈检测中解决拒绝推断偏差问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an LLM-designed dual-stream reward that addresses reject-inference bias in RL-based fraud detection by letting the LLM autonomously choose how to contrast new risk signals with legacy scores for unlabeled transactions blocked by legacy systems.
